info.title: Traicr API
info.description:
The Trace Archive API. Traicr stores one person's AI coding Traces collected from several Source Machines. Use it to find, read, rename, and delete Traces, check imports, and read the server's recent logs.

## Auth
Send `Authorization: Bearer <TRAICR_ADMIN_TOKEN>` on every request. Without a valid token the server answers `401`, except for a `GET` or `HEAD` that carries a valid browser session cookie. This document itself (`GET /api/v1/openapi.json`) needs no token.

## Pagination
These operations page: `listTraces`, `searchEvents`, `listTraceEvents`, `listTraceTranscript`, `listImports`, `listLogs`. They take `limit` (1-200, default 50) and an opaque `cursor`. A response includes `next_cursor` only when another page exists; pass it back unchanged as `cursor`. A cursor keeps its snapshot: rows added after the first page do not appear in later pages. `listMachines`, `listEventSources`, and `listRevisionSources` return plain arrays.

## Errors
Every error response has the shape `{"api_version":1,"_tag":"...","message":"...","error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}}`. `error.code` (repeated as `_tag`) is stable and meant for programs; `error.message` (repeated as `message`) is for people. Each operation lists the codes it can return. `POST /api/v1/imports` is the exception after its upload is received: it answers `200` and reports failures inside its NDJSON stream.

## Dates
`after` and `before` accept `YYYY-MM-DD` (a whole UTC day, inclusive) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

## Words
A **Trace** is one native harness session. An **Event** is a searchable message, tool call, tool result, or model change derived from a Trace. A **Source Record** is the lossless harness-specific data an Event came from. A **Revision** is one collected state of a Trace. An **Import** processes one uploaded Trace ZIP. A **Source Machine** is a computer the Traces were collected on. A **Harness** is the coding tool that produced the Trace, such as `amp`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor`, or `pi`.

get.description: List Traces newest first, one row per Trace. A Child Trace whose parent is collected has no row of its own: browsing skips it, and a match in it returns its top ancestor's row with `matched_child`. Every filter is optional. Event filters (`q`, `model`, `role`, `kind`, `tool`, `after`, `before`) keep a Trace when at least one of its Events matches all of them together; `after` and `before` therefore match Traces with any Event in the range, not their update time.
Search individual Events, newest match first. Each result names its `trace_id`; open it with getTrace or listTraceEvents.
Read one Trace's metadata, Revisions, parent, and child Traces.

patch.description: Set the manual title, which wins over collected and generated titles. Send an empty string to clear it. Imports never change it.

example.message: title_override is required; send an empty string to clear it

error.message: title_override is required; send an empty string to clear it

title_override.description: New manual title, or an empty string to clear it.

delete.description: Permanently delete a Trace, its Events, and Source Records no other Trace uses. This cannot be undone. A later upload of the same session imports it again.

get.description: Page through a Trace's Events in conversation order, merged across Revisions.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Start at the Event with this key instead of the beginning. When set, `cursor` is ignored; page onward with the returned `next_cursor` alone.

get.description:
Page through a Trace's Events in the order the web transcript renders them. For Amp Traces this is Amp's own message and block order, which can differ from listTraceEvents' time order; other harnesses fall back to time order. Each Event carries `revision_id` (the Revision whose observation is shown) and `aliases` (older keys and IDs that link to it). The web UI reads Amp transcripts from here and other harnesses from listTraceEvents; `npm run inspect-trace` in `web/app` turns either into the turns the UI shows.

Unlike other cursors, a transcript cursor does not keep a snapshot. If any Revision of the Trace is imported or normalized again between pages, the next page answers `409 transcript_changed`; start again without a cursor.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Show one Revision's observations instead of the merged archive. Omit or pass `0` for the merged view.

200.description: A page of Events in transcript order.

example.message: invalid search query: invalid transcript cursor

error.message: invalid search query: invalid transcript cursor

409.description: The transcript changed since the first page. Codes: `transcript_changed`.

example.message: transcript changed; reload the page to continue

error.message: transcript changed; reload the page to continue

get.description: List every collected observation of an Event, with where it came from in the original files.
List the original harness files stored for one Revision.
Read one original harness file. With `preview=1` the answer is JSON text (first 1 MiB); otherwise it is the original bytes.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: `1` returns a JSON text preview instead of the bytes.

get.description: List Imports, newest first, with their counts. Per-Trace outcomes are left out because they run to megabytes per Import; read them with `getImport`.

post.description: Upload one Trace ZIP made by `traicr collect` and stream its processing as NDJSON. Only one upload runs at a time. Retrying the same ZIP is safe: unchanged Traces are reported as `unchanged`.

200.description: Upload received. One JSON object per line; the last is `complete` or `failed`.

schema.description: Newline-delimited JSON. Each line is one ImportProgress object (see components.schemas.ImportProgress).

400.description: The upload was incomplete or larger than the server allows. Codes: `upload_failed`.

example.message: upload is incomplete or exceeds the configured limit

error.message: upload is incomplete or exceeds the configured limit

415.description: Body is not a ZIP. Codes: `content_type`.

example.message: send a Trace ZIP with Content-Type: application/zip

error.message: send a Trace ZIP with Content-Type: application/zip

503.description: Another upload is running. Retry after the `Retry-After` seconds. Codes: `import_busy`.

example.message: another import is running; retry this ZIP

error.message: another import is running; retry this ZIP

get.description: Read one Import Report, including every Trace's outcome.
List every Source Machine that has uploaded, most recent first.

One call that answers whether the archive is healthy: each Source Machine's latest import, failed and interrupted imports, Trace and Event totals, the title backlog, and storage size. Uploads rejected before processing are not imports; find them in listLogs as `import rejected`.

Read the server's most recent log records (up to 1,000 kept in memory), newest first. They reset when the server restarts. Use `level=warn` to find problems such as `import rejected`, `import failed`, and `trace naming paused`. Secret values never appear.

400.description: Bad request. A cursor from before a server restart is `invalid_query`. Codes: `invalid_limit`, `invalid_query`.

example.message: invalid or expired cursor; logs start over when the server restarts

error.message: invalid or expired cursor; logs start over when the server restarts

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only records at or after this RFC 3339 time.

title.description: Displayed title: the manual title, else the collected title, else the generated title.

snippet.description: The text that matched `q`, or the first user message.

matched_event_id.description: With `q`, the earliest Event whose text matched, in `matched_child` when that is set. Open it with `?event=` on the Trace page.

matched_child.description: Set when `q` or an Event filter matched a Child Trace of this Trace. Child Traces whose parent is collected are listed under their top ancestor, not on their own.

partial.description: True when the search stopped after its time budget (about 5 seconds) before the page filled, which happens with a regex the index cannot narrow. The page holds what was found so far; pass next_cursor to keep searching.

True when the search stopped after its time budget (about 5 seconds) before the page filled, which happens with a regex the index cannot narrow. The page holds what was found so far; pass next_cursor to keep searching.

observation_count.description: How many collected Revisions contained this Event. Present on listTraceEvents; absent on the Event inside listEventSources.

content.description: Up to the first 1 MiB as text, or a note that the file is binary.

last_seen.description: Start time of the machine's latest import.

title.description: The trace's current display title, set when a stored report is read. Absent while importing and for deleted traces.

failed.description: Traces in this import that failed.

complete.description: False while the import runs or after it was interrupted; its counts are then not final.

failed.description: Traces in this import that failed.

complete.description: False while the import runs or after it was interrupted; its counts are then not final.

ImportSummary.description: An Import's counts without its per-Trace outcomes. Read one Import with `getImport` for those.

ImportProgress.description: One line of the upload's NDJSON stream. The last line is `complete` (with `report`) or `failed` (with `error`).

running_import_id.description: Import being processed right now. Absent when none is.

with_failed_traces.description: Imports whose report lists at least one failed Trace.

incomplete.description: Imports that started but never finished, not counting the running one.

enabled.description: True when the title worker is configured.

pending.description: Untitled Traces whose latest Revision has not been named yet.

objects_bytes.description: Recorded size of stored Source Record files.

seq.description: Increases by one per record since the server started.

attrs.description: Structured fields. Secrets are replaced with `[redacted]`.

q.description: Text to find. Empty matches everything.

after.description: Only Events at or after this time.

example.message: id must be a positive integer

InvalidSearch.description: Bad request. `invalid_query` covers a bad mode, date, regular expression, full-text syntax, or cursor. Codes: `invalid_limit`, `invalid_query`.

example.message: invalid search query: mode must be fulltext, exact, or regex

error.message: invalid search query: mode must be fulltext, exact, or regex

Timeout.description: The request was cancelled, or a search ran longer than 30 seconds; narrow the query. Codes: `cancelled`.

Internal.description: Unexpected server failure; details are in the server logs. Codes: `internal_error`.
